name: R360 Sub: Africa Triage (human approval before MQL routing)
description: Forked from sub-r360-resolver when formattedRegion='Africa'. Posts interactive Slack approval card to Dean Hammond + Kirk Bennett, parks execution on Wait/resume webhook, and resumes resolver with africa_decision = 'continue' or 'kill'. Other regions are not impacted — they bypass this workflow entirely.

nodes.name: When Executed by Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Called by sub-r360-resolver via IF: Africa triage? TRUE branch. Receives full $json with formattedRegion='Africa' plus all normalized fields and SF query results.

nodes.name: SF Upsert: Lead_Inbound_Log__c (africa_pending)
nodes.notes: Bind to [RH] PROD for prod. Provisional log row so replays during the approval window short-circuit (see resolver IF: already written) and the reconciliation cron sees the submission.

nodes.name: Code: Build Slack Block Kit message
nodes.notes: Builds Block Kit JSON with SF links, lead detail, and two URL buttons pointing at $execution.resumeUrl. The Wait node downstream is what gives us the resumeUrl.

nodes.name: Slack: Post triage to MPIM (Dean + Kirk + bot)
nodes.notes: Single group DM to Dean Hammond (U0135HAS0KA) + Kirk Bennett (U02HR1T6PBK) via MPIM channel C0B6JUJEF2M (mpdm-por_revtech--dean.hammond--kirk.bennett-1). Both see the same message with the same action buttons; whoever clicks first resolves the lead.

nodes.name: Slack: notify channel (visibility-only)
nodes.notes: Visibility-only notification to #african-lead-approvals (C0B61KZNXD5). No buttons — interaction goes through the MPIM.

options.responseValue: Decision captured. You can close this window.

nodes.name: Wait: human decision (resume on webhook)
nodes.notes: Resumes when one of the Slack buttons is clicked. Suffix removed because $execution.resumeUrl doesn't include the suffix, causing 404. Decision arrives in $json from the GET query string. Times out per workflow settings.
